source_caption:
🎬 Greater (2016)

Greater tells the inspiring true story of Brandon Burlsworth, an overlooked young football player who dreams of playing for the University of Arkansas despite being told he is too small, too slow, and not talented enough to succeed. Refusing to give up, Brandon joins the team as a walk-on and dedicates himself to becoming a better athlete through hard work, discipline, and determination. With unwavering faith and support from his family, he gradually earns the respect of his coaches and teammates, proving that perseverance can overcome extraordinary obstacles. Combining emotional storytelling, powerful football moments, and an unforgettable journey, the film explores faith, sacrifice, resilience, family, and the importance of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Sports • Drama • Faith-Based

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 10m • PG

🎥 Director: David Hunt

🏆 Recognition: Based on the life of Brandon Burlsworth, one of college football’s most inspiring walk-on players, who earned All-American honors and was selected in the 1999 NFL Draft by the Indianapolis Colts.

source_details.synopsis: Greater is a 2016 American biographical sports film directed by David Hunt and starring Christopher Severio as American football player Brandon Burlsworth, a walk-on college player who became an All-American, dying in a car crash 11 days after being drafted high in the 3rd round to the National Football League. The film was released on August 26, 2016. It was the last film featuring Michael Parks to be released within his lifetime.
